_help: Add or remove items freely; no Python changes needed. keywords: any of these phrases (case-insensitive) must appear in the product title. exclude: skip titles containing these. target_price_usd: alert when the PRODUCT price (USD) is at or below this. target_delivered_usd (optional): alert on the delivered-to-Yerevan price instead. urls (optional): direct product pages to check; only fetched if the site's robots.txt allows it.
